statement: The pinned SDL Switch 2 path performs staged USB bulk setup, factory/user stick calibration and feature/report-selection exchanges before reading input. For Switch 2 Pro it sends HID output rumble command 0x02 with two encoded motor slots, contrasting the Switch 2 GameCube 0x03 simple rumble branch. Host successful open and retail response behavior were not tested.

applicability.scope: SDL staged USB setup and Pro output
